name: CalculateColumnNode
label: Calculate Column
description: Adds a computed column to a data table by evaluating a formula expression that references other columns.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to which the computed column will be added.

fields.name: ColumnName
fields.label: Column Name
fields.description: The name of the new computed column.

fields.name: Expression
fields.label: Expression
fields.description: The expression to evaluate per row. Column names are referenced directly, e.g., 'Price * Quantity' or 'UPPER(Name)'.

fields.name: UpdatedDataTable
fields.label: Updated Data Table
fields.description: The data table with the computed column appended.
